    secondary = 1.0 / (np.arange(len(bins)) + 1)
    secondary_weights = np.where(valid, secondary, 0.0)

    tertiary_weights = np.where(valid, tertiary, 0.0)

    fill_ratio = 1. - remaining_caps / bins
    fill_weight = 1. - fill_ratio

    # Combine reciprocal remaining with penalty to balance fit and usage
    priority = recip_rem - penalty
    # Apply exponential decay to ensure heavily utilized bins are not overly penalized
    priority = np.exp(priority)
